scope: Fresh provider-default Modal, Daytona, E2B, and Tzafon results plus a separate fresh Modal same-region optimized arm

provider_default.caller: external development machine; geographic location not independently recorded

tzafon.move_click_semantics: one coordinate click because no standalone pointer-move action is exposed
tzafon.sequence_semantics: four coordinate clicks in one native batch request

commands.provider_default: uv run computer-use benchmark compare --create-modal-sandbox --provider modal-daemon --provider daytona --provider e2b --provider tzafon --modal-ingress attested-tunnel --resource-profile browser --browser chromium --input-backend xtest --iterations 3 --env-file /path/to/.env --output benchmark-results/candidates/provider-compare-tzafon-2026-07-24.json --json
commands.modal_optimized: uv run computer-use benchmark modal-colocated-client --iterations 30 --modal-region us-west-2 --modal-ingress connect --runner-path connect --surface daemon-http --caller-region-label dev-laptop-us-west --browser chromium --modal-cpu 4 --modal-memory-mib 8192 --runner-cpu 1 --runner-memory-mib 1024 --input-rate-limit-per-sec 0 --input-backend xtest --output benchmark-results/candidates/modal-optimized-tzafon-context-2026-07-24.json --json

startup.metric: product create call to first validated full-screen screenshot decoded by the caller

limitations: The Tzafon tweet's 63 ms browser, 71 ms desktop, and 188 ms E2B values measure server-side TTFB minus TLS handshake over five runs. They are not comparable to this create-to-decoded-screenshot lifecycle or to the warm operation cases.

Tzafon desktop returned 1280x720 JPEG screenshots despite a 1024x768 create request, while Modal, Daytona, and E2B returned 1024x768 PNG screenshots. Screenshot latency is therefore not pixel- or codec-normalized.
Tzafon does not expose a standalone pointer-move action. Its move/click case is one coordinate click, and its eight-logical-action sequence is four coordinate clicks in one native batch.
The provider-default values are contemporaneous within one external-caller run. The Modal optimized arm is a distinct same-region runner configuration and not a provider-default product path.
Requested narrow-region placement is recorded, but this harness does not independently attest the runner's physical availability zone.
The Modal optimized command p95 contains retained high outliers; p50 and the full raw distribution remain available in the ignored raw artifact.
Tzafon public pricing depends on resource usage not exposed by this run, so its cost remains unknown rather than estimated.
